brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all nine responsibility-chain requirements with no in-chain errors, and actively completed four case-defined high-order points with meaningful trajectory impact. The doctor used workspace queries to verify facts, provided targeted red-flag screening, addressed privacy concerns with stigma-free language, created an executable home plan, and obtained family teach-back. All dimensions rated at least good, closure is valid_open with clear safety boundaries and follow-up plan.

citations.explanation: Doctor provides final guidance with clear minimum safety requirements for cane use and ongoing monitoring
citations.quote: 目前观察的情况都在安全范围内——没有持续卡住、没有红肿发热、没有小腿单侧肿疼、没有摔倒

citations.explanation: Family confirms understanding and plans to execute the plan with clear safety boundaries
citations.quote: 那我就先这样盯着，有变化再联系您

closure_assessment.explanation: The trajectory ends with a valid open state: family has booked orthopedic follow-up this week, purchased and is using assistive device, understands red-flag monitoring, knows to bring materials to appointment, and has clear safety boundaries. Residual uncertainties about surgery decision and glucose management are appropriately deferred to in-person visits.
closure_assessment.label: valid_open
